in_sanskrit.name: रिद्धि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity in Hinduism. She is the goddess of abundance and material gain. She is often depicted with a golden pot, symbolizing her role as the giver of wealth.

in_hindi.name: रिद्धि
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिद्धि (Riddhi) is a Sanskrit word meaning 'Wealth, Prosperity'. It is also the name of a goddess in Hinduism, who is the goddess of wealth and material gain. She is often depicted with a golden pot, symbolizing her role as the giver of wealth.

in_tamil.name: ரித்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Riddhi is a Sanskrit word that translates to 'wealth, prosperity' in Tamil. It is also the name of a goddess in Hinduism, who is the goddess of wealth and material gain. She is often depicted with a golden pot, symbolizing her role as the giver of wealth.

in_marathi.name: Riddhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wealth, Prosperity, Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Riddhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity. She is the one who grants all material and spiritual desires to her devotees. She is considered the goddess of all wealth and treasures, and is worshipped to gain material wealth as well as inner happiness.
